desc: The Ace Upland Ultralight is attractive, stylish, and lightweight with smooth shooting inertia and comes in a 24” or 26” barrel. Weighing in at 5.3lbs for the 20 gauge and 6.3lbs for the 12 gauge, the Ace Upland Ultralight is the perfect choice for fast flying grouse in the northwoods or sharpies in the Dakotas. The Ace Upland Ultralight – love-at-first-shouldering with quality to last a lifetime.
